investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Finent Bank (digital banking); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.222.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster finent-prod-apnort (EKS); Database: mysql server statements-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-068c7f4a06ebd15f7; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
